entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. My VeloBand Cadence Sensor is a piece of junk. It's completely broken and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? Do I look like I have time for games? It's not working! It won't sync with the app, it drops connection constantly, it's just plain defective. I've been a VIP customer for years, and this is the quality I get? This is unacceptable. I want a manager and a refund.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the experience you're having. There's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you directly. Let me just pull up your account information. I see you've been a loyal customer with us for a long time, and we truly appreciate that.

Appreciation doesn't fix a broken product. If you can't process a full refund right now, I'll be leaving reviews on every fitness blog and social media site I can find. You'll lose a lot more than the cost of this band.

I assure you, I want to resolve this for you. I'm just checking our policies. One moment... Okay. I see here that your VeloBand was delivered 25 days ago. Our policy allows for returns of defective items within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I am so sorry the device was not working as it should.

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return authorization. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account right now. Once we receive the defective unit, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. And for the trouble this has caused, especially for a valued VIP member, I'd also like to add a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account.
Oh. Well... okay. A full refund and a credit? That's... that's better. I appreciate you taking care of that, Isaac. I was just so angry that it wouldn't sync.
Of course. It's the least we can do. You should see that email with the label shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
